rationale: Expose painted text geometry that Label and TextEditor already compute so a later document-level selection owner can reach the existing hit-test and line-layout behavior without re-deriving it. The new SelectableText interface reports UTF-8 byte offsets and painted line bands; Label records geometry beside its existing fill_text calls, TextEditor projects its existing LayoutSnapshot, and a declared View content region makes supported labels discoverable while preserving existing control gestures outside that region. The focused tests cover UTF-8 cluster boundaries, shaped offsets, wrapped lines, empty and unmeasured layouts, selection bands, region scoping, reparenting, and the no-recording performance control. This is a Pulp view capability and test surface only: no renderer backend, asset pipeline, visual-proof acceptance boundary, or Vellum source authority moves, so the disposition is watch-only.
